Subject: Quick ask — pilot ran out of credits, extension?

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — the engineers were able to wire a short PoC into our staging cluster and the results look promising. We ran through the initial self-serve credits faster than expected while stress-testing some long-context prompts.

Is there a possibility of a small handout or one-off code so we can stretch the pilot another 2–3 weeks? We don't need a long-term contract yet — just enough tokens for several larger runs while we finalize our evaluation plan.

Account info: acme-ai-prod (trial signup 2027-05-02)
Approx usage: 120k tokens/day for 3 days -> exhausted credits
Value ask: ~200k-250k tokens (~$1,800-$2,500 estimate)

Happy to share our usage snapshot or accept an expiring code with clear limits. Objective is to get one more round of engineering validation before we talk capacity sizing.

Best,
Elaine Morris\Director of ML Engineering\Acme AI
